newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Elders, Wesfarmers, WI eye wool jv.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Elders, Wesfarmers, WI eye wool jv.

text.p: A joint venture proposal to take over efforts to establish a forward selling market for wool in Australia from Wool International (WI) was disclosed on Tuesday by WI, Elders Australia Ltd and Wesfarmers Dalgety Ltd.
The proposal would combine efforts to develop a forward market to enhance Australia's competitiveness, the participants said in a joint statement.
"The three parties acknowledge that without a combined approach and effort, much needed reforms in the wool industry will be difficult to achieve," the statement said.
Wool International currently is responsible for selling the Australian wool stockpile.
"We also have an objective to promote the development of forward marketing," a Wool International spokesman said.

If negotiations to form a new joint venture company are successful and the industry and government throw their support behind it, Wool International would no longer be required to establish a separate forward selling market, the statement said.
Under the proposal, the new company would offer services to varying sectors of the wool industry, including brokers and buyers, it said.
